holder_request.summary: 주주는 Alphabet이 기후 목표를 달성하기 위한 계획과 진행 상황에 대한 투명성을 높일 것을 요구하고 있다.

evidence.quote: Shareholders request that Alphabet publish a report, at reasonable cost, within a reasonable time, and excluding confidential or proprietary information, explaining how it will meet the climate change-related commitments it has made on GHGs.

company_response.summary: 회사는 이미 기후 계획과 진행 상황에 대한 상세한 정보를 제공하고 있으며, 추가 보고서는 불필요하다고 주장하고 있다.

evidence.quote: Our existing environmental reporting has long provided detailed and extensive information about our climate plans, progress, policies, and practices.

key_issues.issue: 기후 목표 달성을 위한 추가 보고서의 필요성

evidence.quote: Shareholders request that Alphabet publish a report... explaining how it will meet the climate change-related commitments it has made on GHGs.
Preparing the separate, bespoke report as requested by the proponent would be duplicative and inefficient, administratively burdensome, and an ineffective use of our resources.
